note: Actual shipments confirmed, but the pattern is narrow and must be read carefully: the visible records are NOT commercial exports of Indian-made goods to third-party buyers — they are repair-and-return movements of Russian-origin marine equipment (module M246-002, block AL AM(I)E.467451.019-001) between the Indian entity and its Russian parent/affiliate Concern Avrora Scientific and Production Association JSC, St Petersburg, plus one re-import of an unrepairable module. Direction is India->Russia and Russia->India, all via Sahar Air Cargo ACC (Mumbai). So: real customs activity exists with dates, destinations and B/L numbers, but it evidences an intra-group service/repair channel, not independent export sales. No domestic supply trail found — 'следов поставок на внутренний рынок не найдено'. HS discrepancy: declared 852351 (solid-state storage media) does not match any observed record; actual codes seen are 85371090 (control panels/boards) and 85389000 (parts for switchgear) — per project rules this is not a rejection ground, code should be corrected to 85371090 as the dominant observed code, verdict accepted_hs_corrected.
